requirements.description: I/B/E/S U.S. quarterly firm earnings observations and the most timely individual analyst forecast available strictly before the quarter’s earnings report date, plus fiscal-quarter key and event/forecast timing fields needed to form surprise distributions and annual fiscal-year summaries. Required fiscal years are 1984–1999; the paper requires a report date and at least one earlier forecast per observation. The current local Detail History product has candidate actual, forecast, fiscal-period and timing columns, but their semantic mapping to the historical detail-file fields remains unverified.

required_coverage.frequency: Quarterly firm events/forecasts; outcomes aggregated by fiscal year.
required_coverage.population: U.S. I/B/E/S detail-file firm-quarter earnings observations with a quarterly report date and at least one analyst forecast before that date; the source reports 176,519 observations.
required_coverage.detail: Original fiscal years 1984–1999; raw inputs are quarterly actual earnings, individual forecast values and forecast dates, fiscal period ends, report/event dates, currency/measure and U.S.-firm indicators. No lag, lead, or rolling estimation window is specified.

routes.source_name: I/B/E/S Detail History - Detail File with Actuals (EPS for US Region)
routes.mapping_notes: Candidate columns are TICKER/CUSIP (firm keys), FPEDATS (fiscal-quarter period), VALUE (forecast value), ACTUAL (candidate reported actual), MEASURE/FPI/CURR/CURR_ACT/USFIRM (measure, period, currency and U.S.-firm descriptors), and ANNDATS/ANNTIMS plus ACTDATS fields (forecast and actual/report timing). The assigned source requires reported EPS less the most recent individual forecast dated before the earnings report. The exact meaning and event alignment of the current columns, including the paper’s report-date field and how to select the forecast, are not independently established by a one-row probe, so semantic mapping and ticker-period identification remain unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact resource is readable and all listed fields were included in a successful bounded probe. No frozen local coverage confirmation supports 1984–1999 U.S. firm-quarter coverage or the paper’s reported 176,519-observation population; the sampled row and catalog count do not establish it.

evidence.quote: My primary data source is the I/B/E/S International Inc. U.S. detail file, where I obtain 176,519 quarterly observations of actual earnings and analyst forecasts spanning the 16 years, 1984–1999.
The only constraints I impose for my principal analyses are that the I/B/E/S file contains the quarterly earnings report date, and that at least one earnings forecast be made before that date
I define earnings surprise as actual reported quarterly earnings minus the analyst forecast closest to, but before, the quarter’s earnings announcement.
I run separate regressions of median surprise on the fiscal year representing the firm’s fiscal quarter
The trend and the t-value pertain to the slope coefficient of the univariate regression of the column on fiscal year.
evidence.description: Reported univariate slope and t-value; no named estimator.
